body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 4cf80a9ebc9249eb6ef3b7fcf360289ae6681019 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The stated fan spans meet the completion criteria in #1172. The code keeps the fold, crossing, kerf and machine-limit checks. It gives a named refusal for several open runs on one plane. The decision file explains the choice and the alternatives.

I did this safety review locally. I merged the PR head with upstream/main at c785c14b in a separate worktree. The merge had no conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

Results:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed.
- Motion unit tests: 343 passed, 5 ignored.
- Motion `wire_fans`: 7 passed.
- App unit tests: 305 passed, 1 ignored.
- App `wire_4axis`: 8 passed, including the existing golden checks.
- App `wire_fans`: 2 passed, including generation, verification and U/V posting.
- App `wire_stamp`: 7 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

I repeated two mutation checks:
1. With the seam fix removed, `an_upper_apex_fan_can_wrap_the_lower_ring_seam` failed with a crossed-pair refusal.
2. With the upper whole-ring guard removed, `a_whole_upper_ring_fan_is_refused_as_ambiguous` failed. The error came from the kerf check instead of the required ambiguity check.

I restored the source after each check. All 7 motion fan tests then passed. The worktree had no source changes after these checks.

No CL or NC goldens changed. There were no moved golden lines to check. No UI files changed, so before and after screenshots are not required. No dependency, build script or workflow changes were present.

Requested changes: none.

Real EDM controls and release-only tests were not exercised.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
